text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While visiting a zoo with Copano
Rickey...

text_block_list.name: Familiar Voice
text_block_list.text:
Huwhaa?! Stop right there, monkey!
That stuffed
toy is MINE!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hm? That voice is... Fukukitaru?! Let's go
check it
out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
M-my lucky penguin... Spirited away by
a
monkey...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I've hit rock-bottom unhappiness! No
doubt, my
fortune's going to read...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I-I knew it! The worst luck possible!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hey, Fukukitaru! Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah! Master Rickey!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I've fallen into a pit of rotten luck!
Pleeease, use
your feng shui expertise to
pull me out!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see. So, the stuffed toy you won from
the
souvenir store raffle was taken by a
monkey, huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... The lottery is all sold out, so I
can't even
buy another one. Both my
luck and mood are
down the drain!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I understand the situation! Allow
me to
solve your problem, Copa-style! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru, your personal trigram is
"qian" right?
It seems that your qi today
isn't syncing well with
the earth... This
means you should avoid things
like
mountains, soil, rock, the colors yellow
and
brown. And further, the northeast...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's right... this is the zoo's
northeastern zone!
Also, the monkey
area was built to emulate a
mountain
with its rocky formations and bare

earth... Plus, the monkeys are brown...
EEEK!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But don't panic! We'll be able to
improve your
negative energy flow by
weakening the earth's
elemental qi with
wood! And since we're at the
zoo...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa! Welcome to the bunny
corner! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Lush green trees in the eastern corner
and rabbits
which symbolize wood!
You'll be able to soak up
plenty of
positive energy here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! This is total heaven! As Doto
might say,
there was hope for salvation
after all!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh. ♪ Wasn't that area just fantastic
with all its
greenery and fluffiness?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
U-um... So, now that I've absorbed a
bounty of
wood energy, my fortune
should soon skyrocket,
right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well... Of course, I think you've been set
on the
path to happiness. But, don't
forget that feng shui
is only a method of
drawing out positive energy
and
harmonizing with your environment.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The rest is up to you! Happiness is
something you
need to seize with your
own hands! It comes to
those who go
forth with a positive mindset!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I-I see...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But I believe in you, Fukukitaru! You're
always
earnestly seeking happiness! Plus,
I'll be here to
offer my support if you
need it. Let's become
happy together!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
O-oh... W-well, hearing that from you
makes me
think I actually can!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But, I guess I'll have to accept that I
won't be
getting my stuffed toy back.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Nuh-uh, we still have options! Hey,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Let's at least see if anyone
knows
anything. Things might turn out to
our benefit!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
I'm really sorry for the trouble! We
actually had
another one of those
stuffed toys in storage.
Here, I've
brought it out for you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I totally didn't think of just asking the
staff! You
always know exactly what to
do, Master Rickey!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So, then, what are you going to do now,

Fukukitaru?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well... I'm still worried about my luck
turning bad
again, so I think I'm gonna
head back to the
academy before
anything else happens.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Aww, what a waste! We bumped into
each other,
so we should hang out
longer! Come on, it'll be a
lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Rickey...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I need to think positively
and seize
happiness with my own hands.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Okay... Let's continue hanging out! And
actually,
I've barely seen any of the zoo
at all. So, I want to
have as much fun as
possible while I'm here!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit, Fukukitaru! Let's get
going!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three of us end up having a pleasant
time at
the zoo.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's right! The other souvenir stores
should be
located on the zoo map!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Ah, there's one more location!
Let's check
it out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Found it! And they still have loads of
raffle prizes
left!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Which means I'll have to draw another
lot. Feng
shui may have helped me out
earlier, but my base
luck is still through
the floor...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine! You've got both feng shui
and us on
your side! If you just believe in
yourself and act
positively, you'll seize
that happiness!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Master! Y-you're right. Think
positively... I'm
here to win!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: O-one more time!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm not finished yet!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: This time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I-I did it! I got another lucky penguin!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I see now—having a positive mindset is
super
important for achieving happiness.
It's all thanks
to your words of support,
Rickey!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I merely showed you the path of feng
shui! It was
you who beckoned the
happiness to yourself,
Fukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru's face lights up with
pride
upon hearing Copano Rickey's
response.
